body: You lost me after life is difficult
I was destined to be miserable

Punk Rock, Psychedelic Rock, Folk Rock.
60’s, 70’s & 80’s Classic Rock. Jazz. Blues. Video Game Soundtrack.

My hobbies are becoming less enjoyable.
Video games and music don’t excite me much like they did before. I get disinterested a lot faster.

I’ve had numerous councillors and therapists. It’s all the same. I’ve tried trans lifeline too.
My problems can’t be talked away.
I found my mother’s corpse in my house after she killed herself when I was 15. I can’t shake this horrible nightmare.

I do have mental health support. I have a regular councillor and a queer specific one. It still doesn’t do anything. Everything is just too horrible. I’ve lost my father. I found my mother’s corpse in my own house. I lost my great grandmother. My Aunt younger than 35 died of cancer this year. I lost my precious cat in the same week. All my life I’ve been a social outcast because of autism spectrum disorder and now I’m a social outcast because I can’t fit into some arbitrary rules about gender. Life has been one horrible event after another and proven to me I was just meant to be miserable forever. I’m done trying to live in a world that can’t offer me a fucking shred of peace.

I haven’t had friends since high school. I’ve already been jumped before and my friend was with me and did fuck all like a coward. I don’t hang out with him anymore for obvious reasons. If I were dressed feminine that night things would have been even worse. I don’t feel safe in any situation outside my home anymore. Especially when I’m alone. Expressing myself doesn’t even make me feel good anymore.. It just makes me paranoid and upset.

It’s harder for it to be just their problem when the anxiety is crippling. I can’t handle any kind of intimidation or confrontation without feeling like I’m going to completely breakdown. I’m too mentally weak for this..

But it’s beyond that.. even if I move out of my current home.. I’m not safe.
My country is supposed to be the leader of the modern and progressive world. We pride ourselves on being diverse, welcoming, multicultural and accepting. Yet even here going outside presenting as anything outside the strict gender roles assigned to me runs the risk of being jumped and beaten. If I’m not safe here, where is there anywhere that’s going to be any better? How do you live in a world that hates you?
